repos.description: Calculate AMD SEV/SEV-ES/SEV-SNP measurement for confidential computing
Remote attestation for Trusted and Confidential Computing platforms (TPM, AMD SEV-SNP, Intel SGX/TDX)

The Automata AMD SEV-SNP Attestation SDK is a software development kit designed to help users generate the AMD SEV-SNP Attestation Report using Rust across different cloud service providers, and generate Risc0 and SP1 ZK Proofs which can be verified on-chain. Powered by Automata
